summary: Ramsey County, MN 65 ft fire tower on the State Fair grounds, listed as a replica; climbable during the fair; NHLR-registered 2015.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list calls it a replica. None of the pages we read says what it copies

access.note: Climbable during the State Fair, weather permitting. We found no statement on access outside the fair

events.note: Visit report dated January 30, 2004 says the tower is now completed
Registered January 3, 2015; nominated by Paul Munns

evidence.supports: 2004 visit report: the tower is now completed
evidence.quote: Minnesota State Fair Lookout tower is now completed.

evidence.supports: administered by the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources
location Minnesota State Fair, Ramsey County, Minnesota
65-foot tower; invitation to climb for a view of the fairgrounds, weather permitting
evidence.quote: Climb a 65-foot-tall fire tower for a panoramic view of the fairgrounds (weather permitting)

evidence.supports: FFLA list: replica, tower standing, NHLR US 1067
evidence.quote: Minnesota State Fair (Replica) Ramsey 44.97968 -93.17334 Tower Standing

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, design, or original structure is in the pages we read, so the built section rests on a 2004 visit report saying the tower was completed. The replica label has no explanation in any readable source. Search snippets attributed to the Minnesota DNR (dnr.state.mn.us/statefair/dnr_building.html) and to a State Fair social post say the tower was built in 1966 as an educational exhibit, retired in 1978, and reopened in 2007. Those statements were not in the cached DNR page, and they are not quoted here. Fetch a page that states them, then add the built and fate events with quotes. The DNR page we fetched is a photo-history page and gives no tower details. Fetch failed for the OpenStreetMap link.
